create.name: Tara Mandala Landau an der Isar
create.bio:
Tara Mandala is a small Tibetan Buddhist centre for teaching and meditation in Fichtheim, part of Landau an der Isar in Lower Bavaria, Germany. It follows the Gelug tradition, looks to the Dalai Lama as a guiding example, and has been an FPMT centre since 2008; it is a registered non-profit association and belongs to the German Buddhist Union. Dieter Kratzer founded the meditation centre at Fichtheim with his wife Maria, and he remains its resident teacher, with long-standing students leading many sessions.

Each week there are talks applying the Buddha's teachings to everyday life, held on Tuesday mornings in Landau and on Tuesday evenings in nearby Deggendorf, and a Wednesday evening class on the basics of Buddhism and meditation, all also streamed online, plus a monthly meditation for children. The year includes a Vajrasattva purification retreat at New Year and a ten-day lam-rim retreat each August, and between courses the house can be used for solitary retreats. Teaching is in German, and members support the centre with a modest monthly contribution.

courses.title: Meditation & Kurse
courses.description: The weekly programme: talks on applying the Buddha's wisdom to daily life (Tuesdays, Landau and Deggendorf) and a basics class on Buddhism and meditation (Wednesdays, Landau), all with online access, plus a monthly children's meditation and a twice-yearly beginners' meditation course.

courses.title: Vajrasattva Retreat
courses.description: A several-day purification retreat to begin the new year, with sessions led by Carola, a long-time student of the centre's teacher, held on site and online.

courses.title: Lam Rim Retreat
courses.description: The yearly ten-day summer retreat on the stages of the path, with six meditation sessions a day from morning until evening prayers. Participants can stay at home, in the centre's rooms or at a guesthouse.

courses.title: Einzelretreat
courses.description: Rooms for a self-guided solitary retreat between courses, for days, weeks or months. Retreatants cater for themselves in the shared kitchen, keep the house rules of a vegetarian, alcohol-free home, and arrange guidance with their own teacher.

courses.title: Mitglied werden
courses.description: Membership of the association, with a newsletter, a vote at the annual meeting in March and a free half-day course each year for supporters.
courses.price: empfohlen 10,00 Euro monatlich (Einzelpersonen), 15,00 Euro (Paare oder Familien), ermäßigt 5,00 Euro
